children: Diane Swonk, chief economist at KPMG, said the August jobs report showed mixed but strong labor market signals, according to Bloomberg. U.S. payrolls rose by 162,000, above expectations, while the unemployment rate held at 4.1%.
The report also included revisions to prior figures, and Swonk said the data contain a lot of noise.

title: KPMG's Diane Swonk Sees Mixed Signals in August Jobs Report
